_about: Shared test set for the sensitive-mail filter. Used by backend/api/tests.py and tests/sensitive.test.js so the Python and JS rules stay identical. expect=hidden means the whole mail is replaced by a stub; expect=visible means it must pass through, with every must_keep string still present and every must_remove string gone.
